segments.sn12.57:1.1: Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati … pe …“saṃyojaniyesu, bhikkhave, dhammesu assādānupassino viharato taṇhā pavaḍḍhati.
segments.sn12.57:1.3: Taṇhāpaccayā upādānaṃ … pe … evametassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hoti”.
segments.sn12.57:2.2: Tassa puriso kālena kālaṃ mūlāni palimajjeyya [palisanneyya (sī.), palisajjeyya (syā. kaṃ. pī.), palipaṭṭheyya (ka.), palisandeyya, palibandheyya (ṭīkānurūpaṃ)] kālena kālaṃ paṃsuṃ dadeyya, kālena kālaṃ udakaṃ dadeyya.
segments.sn12.57:2.3: Evañhi so, bhikkhave, taruṇo rukkho tadāhāro tadupādāno vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjeyya.
segments.sn12.57:2.4: Evameva kho, bhikkhave, saṃyojaniyesu dhammesu assādānupassino viharato taṇhā pavaḍḍhati.
segments.sn12.57:2.5: Taṇhāpaccayā upādānaṃ … pe … evametassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hoti.
segments.sn12.57:3.1: “Saṃyojaniyesu, bhikkhave, dhammesu ādīnavānupassino viharato taṇhā nirujjhati.
segments.sn12.57:3.2: Taṇhānirodhā upādānanirodho … pe … evametassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa nirodho hoti.
segments.sn12.57:4.2: Atha puriso āgaccheyya kuddālapiṭakaṃ ādāya … pe … nadiyā vā sīghasotāya pavāheyya.
segments.sn12.57:4.4: Evañhi so, bhikkhave, taruṇo rukkho ucchinnamūlo assa tālāvatthukato anabhāvaṅkato āyatiṃ anuppādadhammo.
segments.sn12.57:4.5: Evameva kho, bhikkhave, saṃyojaniyesu dhammesu ādīnavānupassino viharato taṇhā nirujjhati.
segments.sn12.57:4.6: Taṇhānirodhā upādānanirodho … pe … evametassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa nirodho hotī”ti.

lines: Paṃsuṃ dadeyyāti thaddhapharusapaṃsuṃ haritvā mudugomayacuṇṇamissaṃ madhurapaṃsuṃ pakkhipeyya.
Vuddhinti vuddhiṃ āpajjitvā pupphūpago pupphaṃ, phalūpago phalaṃ gaṇheyya.

Idaṃ panettha opammasaṃsandanaṃ – taruṇarukkho viya hi tebhūmakavaṭṭaṃ, rukkhajaggako puriso viya vaṭṭanissito puthujjano, mūlaphalasantānādīni viya tīhi dvārehi kusalākusalakammāyūhanaṃ, rukkhassa vuḍḍhiāpajjanaṃ viya puthujjanassa tīhi dvārehi kammaṃ āyūhato aparāparaṃ vaṭṭappavatti.
Tathā karonto yasmā ca tattha tiṇagacchādīnaṃ mūlasantānaggahaṇena taṃ ṭhānaṃ sodheti nāma, tasmā vuttaṃ “sodheyyā”ti.
